selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: In the parable, who does the king stand for?
questions.answer: Allah, our Creator and Sustainer.

questions.question: What do the estates and tools stand for in a person’s life?
questions.answer: A person’s belongings, body, heart, spirit, and senses.

questions.question: Which person is the noble lieutenant in the parable?
questions.answer: The Messenger of Allah.

questions.question: What does the wise decree stand for?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the battle area stand for?
questions.answer: This changing world.

questions.question: What big worry do people feel when they see things changing and passing away?
questions.answer: They wonder if there is a way to keep things from being lost forever.

questions.question: What answer does the Qur’an give to that worry?
questions.answer: It says there is a good and easy way.

questions.question: What is that way?
questions.answer: To give the trust back to its real Owner.

questions.question: Who is the true Owner of the trust?
questions.answer: Allah.

questions.question: What kind of result comes from this trade?
questions.answer: It brings five benefits.

questions.question: Who is being spoken to at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: The nafs, meaning the selfish side of a person.

questions.question: What is the parable helping the reader see?
questions.answer: The truth.

questions.question: In the passage, what are some of the inner and outer gifts Allah gave people?
questions.answer: The eye, tongue, mind, imagination, heart, and spirit.

questions.question: Why is the world compared to a rough battlefield?
questions.answer: Because it keeps changing and nothing stays the same.

questions.question: What happens to things in this world according to the passage?
questions.answer: They pass away, break apart, and change.

questions.question: When people notice that things do not last, what question do they ask?
questions.answer: They ask if there is a way to make what they have lasting.

questions.question: From where does the answer come?
questions.answer: From the Qur’an.

questions.question: How is the way described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is beautiful and easy.

questions.question: What does it mean to sell the trust back?
questions.answer: It means giving what Allah gave us back to Him by using it for Him.

questions.question: What does the passage say this sale brings?
questions.answer: Five kinds of gain.

questions.question: Who is the Monarch of before and after all time in the parable?
questions.answer: Allah.

questions.question: Besides a person’s things, what other parts of a person are included in the trust?
questions.answer: The body, soul, heart, senses, mind, and imagination.

questions.question: Which two senses are named clearly in the passage?
questions.answer: The eye and the tongue.

questions.question: What is the job of the Messenger in the parable picture?
questions.answer: He is the noble messenger who brings the message.
